In [[3955 BBY]],<ref name="Birthdate" /> a [[Gender/Legends|female]], the '''daughter''' of an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Onderonian military]] named [[Gelesi]], was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]].<ref name="kotor2" /> By [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="kotorcg">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Gelesi was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a [[Gelesi's wife|woman]]; the couple and their daughter lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Once Gelesi inherited a position as [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]] after his [[Sullio|predecessor]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]], he grew paranoid that he would share the same fate. Fear for his life and the lives of his family members fueled Gelesi's anxiety and drove him to consider secretly evacuating his family from Onderon, although he decided against it.<ref name="kotor2" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I have a wife and daughter to look after. And I feel like a target now. I'm tempted to just grab my family and take the first shuttle out of here.|Gelesi, if the Exile supported Vaklu|audio=Gelesi-Family.flac|<ref name="kotor2" />}}
Gelesi mentions his daughter in [[Obsidian Entertainment]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' if the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]], the player's character, decides to support [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaklu]]'s [[Onderon Civil War|efforts]] to become [[King/Legends|king]] of Onderon, instead of defending the current regent, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Talia (Onderon)|Talia]], during her first visit to Onderon in the game. The player is then able to convince Gelesi to leave the planet. If the latter option is chosen, Gelesi professes his concern for his family, information that can be used as leverage to persuade him to leave Onderon. Additionally, the player can convince a [[Beast Riders|Beast Rider]] named [[Panar]] to threaten to kidnap and marry Gelesi's daughter as another means of coaxing the captain to leave.<ref name="kotor2" /> This elective has not been given an official [[canon]]ical option, but, because ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' established that the Exile supported Talia during a [[Battle of Onderon (Onderon Civil War)|second visit]],<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> this article assumes she supported the queen during her first visit and that Gelesi was not convinced to emigrate.
